kind: independent pre-review verification of another actor's branch (no code changes, nothing pushed to that branch)
model_observed: reported to the coordinator in the session handoff, not recorded in Git
environment: Cloud container: Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS, kernel 6.18.44, rustc 1.97.0, node v22.22.0 (CI uses node 20), webkit2gtk-driver 2.52.6-0ubuntu0.24.04.1, tauri-driver from `cargo install tauri-driver --locked`, webdriverio 9.29.1, xvfb-run. Fresh per-run app-data via XDG_* temp dirs created by the runner; library = copy of committed synthetic fixtures. No owner library, no dev server, no network services.

criteria.criterion: 1. Clean checkout builds the actual debug Tauri package and runs the desktop driver against that binary with committed synthetic EPUB/PDF fixtures and fresh isolated app-data; no owner library or dev server.
criteria.action: git worktree of 48b659a; npm ci; npm run fixtures:check; npx tauri build --debug --bundles deb; dpkg-deb -x; ran run-packaged.mjs against pkg/usr/bin/desktop
criteria.expected: deb builds; runner uses the packaged binary; webview origin is not a localhost dev server
criteria.observed: build exit 0; deb sha256 59d9ff27…a730, binary sha256 819cb540…b5d0; webview_origin tauri://localhost; fixtures:check exit 0
evidence: scratch ev/build-identity.txt (not committed; reproduced in CI artifact once PR CI runs)

criteria.criterion: 2. Tab rail + fixture-sized library, search a known fixture, open it, turn a page, return to Library and search again; responsive; restart the same packaged build and verify library + recorded positions restore.
criteria.action: run-1 and run-2: 20 steps each incl. first-run form indexing, search 'quillfeather', open PDF p1→p2, sidecar position 2 via get_sidecar, back to Library + search 'zephyr', open EPUB + Next (CFI advanced), close app, relaunch same binary on same app-data
criteria.expected: 3 fixture cards; PDF reopens at page 2; EPUB reopens at the saved CFI; library_path persisted without re-selecting folder
criteria.observed: run-1 pass 20/20 in 8.7s, run-2 pass 20/20 in 8.1s; PDF restored page 2; EPUB position and reopened both epubcfi(/6/2!/4/14/1:0); library re-listed in 105ms/4ms

criteria.criterion: 3. Missing/corrupt fixture or failing assertion → nonzero result with useful evidence; stalled run bounded; driver/app processes cleaned; rerun with clean app-data is repeatable.
criteria.action: npm run test:e2e:packaged:failures (assert, missing-fixture, corrupt-fixture, stall) + two independent clean runs above
criteria.expected: exit 1 for assert/missing/corrupt with named failing step; exit 124 for stall; 0 leftover processes
criteria.observed: assert→1 (expected 4 cards saw 3); missing-fixture→1 (EPUB card absent); corrupt-fixture→1 (reader error InvalidPDFException); stall→124 after 30.8s; leftover_processes 0 for all; verifier exit 0

criteria.criterion: 4. Current-head CI/build/driver evidence and exact binary identity; agent smokes the delivered Windows application at its actual entrypoint.
criteria.action: none possible from this worker: no PR exists, so no PR CI run for 48b659a; Windows is coordinator-owned
criteria.expected: green desktop-e2e job on the PR head with uploaded desktop-e2e-evidence artifact; Windows smoke

ci.conclusion: not run: CI triggers on pull_request/main push only and no PR exists for this branch

review_notes: EPUB restart assertion accepts any reopened CFI different from the opening CFI; observed values were exactly equal, so tightening to equality (or same-section) would be stricter without flakiness evidence. Optional.
desktop-e2e job runs `cargo install tauri-driver --locked` uncached on every run (adds build minutes); optional cache.
Debug binary hash is not reproducible across machines; identity is tied to the CI artifact, so the coordinator should compare against the CI build-identity.txt, not this container's hash.
local_verification_required: Windows: build exe/NSIS/MSI from the merged SHA and smoke the installed app at its real entrypoint with a library + app-data isolated via a separate Windows user profile or VM (APPDATA override does NOT isolate the known-folder app-data path).
Windows: open fixture EPUB + PDF, turn page, quit, relaunch, confirm positions restore.
review_walkthrough: Open the PR's desktop-e2e job → download desktop-e2e-evidence → run-1/report.json shows 20 ok steps and webview_origin tauri://localhost (criterion 1-2).
known_risks: Linux WebKitWebDriver evidence only; says nothing about WebView2/Windows.
